summary: The diff implements all three requirements (REQ-11, REQ-12, REQ-13) with good coverage. The /images folder is created with a .gitkeep, image src attributes in pages reference /images paths, a .env file is created with all required variables, and a README.md is documented. One notable gap: the actual placeholder image files (hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png, service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png, etc.) are not present in the diff — only a .gitkeep file was added to frontend/public/images/. Overall the implementation is largely complete with the image file gap being the main concern.
